about.title: Trust built into every sheet
about.intro: HTPLY Vietnam is an industrial plywood exporter focused on the mid-to-premium segment for international B2B customers. With a factory footprint of around 5,000 m² and a supply capacity of up to 80 containers/month, HTPLY focuses on developing Film Faced Plywood, Anti-Slip Plywood and industrial plywood lines, targeting the European and Middle Eastern markets. The company builds its global expansion strategy on consistent quality, supply capacity and sustainable development.

items.q: What is the minimum order quantity (MOQ)?
items.a: The standard MOQ is one 20ft/40ft container per order. For smaller orders, please contact us directly to discuss consolidation options.

items.q: How long does production and delivery take?
items.a: The average time from order confirmation to loading is about 30 days, depending on specifications and container quantity.
Yes. Quality records, thickness/moisture/bond-strength testing and export documents are provided in full for every shipment.

items.q: Can sizes and thicknesses be customized?
items.a: Yes, customization is available based on the buyer's technical requirements. Please send specific specs via the "Request a Quote" form for an accurate quotation.

items.q: Which markets does HTPLY ship to?
items.a: Currently focused on the European and Middle Eastern markets, with the possibility to expand based on specific shipping route requirements.

intro.title: A Vietnamese plywood brand built for the global market
intro.text: HTPLY VIETNAM was founded in 2024, specializing in plywood and engineered wood panels for the international B2B market. With a factory of around 5,000 m² and a supply capacity of up to 80 containers/month, HTPLY focuses on developing Film Faced Plywood, Anti-Slip Plywood and industrial plywood lines, while targeting the European and Middle Eastern markets. The company builds its global expansion strategy on consistent quality, supply capacity and sustainable development.

approach.text: HTPLY doesn't see a product as a single, standalone board. Every order is the result of an operational chain covering material selection, pressing, surface treatment, quality inspection, packaging and logistics.
